title: Fix LP: #2137443
description:
Fixes bug (LP: #2137443) where coreutils-from and libdigest-sha3-perl 
both try to install usr/bin/sha3sum by making them both access sha3sum 
using dh_alternatives.

In libdigest-sha3-sum:
  * Register sha3sum as alternative to fix conflict with
  	coreutils-from.
  	- d/rules: Rename sha3sum to sha3sum-perl.
  	- d/libdigest-sha3-perl.alternatives: Add sha3sum-perl as
  	  an alternative.

In coreutils-from:
  * Add sha3sum as alternative to fix conflict with 
    libdigest-sha3-perl.
    - d/rules: 
      + Prevent sha3sum from being added to .links.
      + Add private symlinks for dh_alternatives.
    - Add .alternative files for sha3sum:
      + d/coreutils-from-busybox.alternatives
      + d/coreutils-from-toybox.alternatives
      + d/coreutils-from-uutils.alternatives
    - Modify .links files to not include sha3sum:

PPA: ppa:varranvar/dev

Steps to test:

# lxc launch ubuntu-daily:resolute tester
# lxc exec tester -- bash
# apt update
# apt install libdigest-sha3-perl

* This install should fail.

# sudo add-apt-repository -y ppa:varranvar/dev
# sudo apt upgrade
# apt install libdigest-sha3-perl

* This install should succeed.

diff --git a/debian/rules b/debian/rules
index cd69529..c3cb1ec 100755
--- a/debian/rules
+++ b/debian/rules
@@ -8,13 +8,25 @@ GNU_COREUTILS_VERSION := 9.5-1ubuntu2
 %:
 	dh $@
 
+execute_before_dh_installalternatives:
+	mkdir -p debian/coreutils-from-uutils/usr/lib/coreutils-from
+	ln -sf /usr/lib/cargo/bin/coreutils/sha3sum \
+		debian/coreutils-from-uutils/usr/lib/coreutils-from/sha3sum.uutils
+
+	mkdir -p debian/coreutils-from-busybox/usr/lib/coreutils-from
+	ln -sf /usr/bin/busybox \
+		debian/coreutils-from-busybox/usr/lib/coreutils-from/sha3sum.busybox
+
+	mkdir -p debian/coreutils-from-toybox/usr/lib/coreutils-from
+	ln -sf /usr/bin/toybox \
+		debian/coreutils-from-toybox/usr/lib/coreutils-from/sha3sum.toybox
 
 update-links:
 	# gnu-coreutils we take everything
 	dpkg -L gnu-coreutils | sed s#^/## | grep -E '(man.|bin)/gnu' | sort -u | while read x; do echo $$x $$(echo $$x | sed s#/gnu#/#); done  > debian/coreutils-from-gnu.links
 	# rust-coreutils we take everything too, except more
 	( coreutils --list | sed 's#.*#usr/lib/cargo/bin/coreutils/\0 usr/bin/\0#' ; \
-	dpkg -L rust-coreutils | sed s#^/## | grep -E 'man./rust-' | sort -u | while read x; do echo $$x $$(echo $$x | sed s#/rust-#/#); done ) | grep -vE '/(more|kill|hostname|uptime)'  > debian/coreutils-from-uutils.links
+	dpkg -L rust-coreutils | sed s#^/## | grep -E 'man./rust-' | sort -u | while read x; do echo $$x $$(echo $$x | sed s#/rust-#/#); done ) | grep -vE '/(more|kill|hostname|uptime|sha3sum)'  > debian/coreutils-from-uutils.links
 
 	# [ usually has no manual page, we need to add one
 	echo usr/share/man/man1/gnutest.1.gz usr/share/man/man1/[.1.gz >> debian/coreutils-from-gnu.links
@@ -24,8 +36,10 @@ update-links:
 	sed -nr 's#.*bin/([^/]*)$$#\1#gp' debian/coreutils-from-gnu.links debian/coreutils-from-uutils.links | sort -u > debian/real-coreutils.list
 	busybox --list > debian/busybox.list
 	comm -12 debian/real-coreutils.list debian/busybox.list | sed 's#^#usr/bin/busybox usr/bin/#' > debian/coreutils-from-busybox.links
+
 	toybox | tr ' ' '\n' | sort > debian/toybox.list
 	comm -12 debian/real-coreutils.list debian/toybox.list | sed 's#^#usr/bin/toybox usr/bin/#' > debian/coreutils-from-toybox.links
+
 	rm debian/*.list
